hints.title: Pairwise Substring Check
hints.text: A string words[i] is a match if there exists some other string words[j] with distinct index containing words[i] as a substring.

hints.title: Length Optimization
hints.text: Only strings strictly longer than words[i] can contain words[i] as a substring.

hints.title: Collect Unique Substrings
hints.text: Check words[i] against all words[j]. If found in any words[j], add it to the result and advance to the next word.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.whyNaiveFails: Comparing words with themselves creates false matches.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Since N <= 100 and L <= 30, pairwise substring search runs in fractions of a millisecond.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate checks substring containment across pairs excluding identical indices.
complexity.notes: Returned array order does not matter.
